repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

errors.name: AuthenticationRequired
errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: It was not queued, as the reason says.

base.description: The branch whose queue it is in.

position.description: Its place in that queue, from 1.

ejectedBefore.description: Queued again at the very head the queue last ejected, why it was: unless that was not the pull's doing, it will be ejected again.

main.description: Puts an open pull at the back of its target branch's merge queue, as `knotless pull merge --queue` does, as the account logged in to this appview's web pages, and returns at once with its place: a runner the repository names lands it with the batch it is in once that passes. One queued already keeps its place. The owner and collaborators may, in a repository that names runners. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

description: Puts a pull in its branch's merge queue as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
